progress.caption: Preparing grocery demo products and images

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/plugin.php';
global $wp_version;
$errors = array();
if ( '7.0.2' !== $wp_version ) { $errors[] = 'Expected WordPress 7.0.2, got ' . $wp_version; }
if ( ! defined( 'WC_VERSION' ) || '11.0.0' !== WC_VERSION ) { $errors[] = 'Expected WooCommerce 11.0.0.'; }
if ( ! is_plugin_active( 'storefront-core/storefront-core.php' ) ) { $errors[] = 'Storefront Core is not active.'; }
if ( 'storefront-theme' !== get_stylesheet() ) { $errors[] = 'Storefront Theme is not active.'; }
$products = wc_get_products( array( 'limit' => -1, 'return' => 'ids' ) );
if ( count( $products ) < 6 ) { $errors[] = 'Expected at least six seeded grocery products.'; }
$attachments = get_posts( array( 'post_type' => 'attachment', 'post_status' => 'inherit', 'posts_per_page' => -1, 'fields' => 'ids', 'meta_key' => '_bhaivatech_modern_grocery_asset_id' ) );
if ( 6 !== count( $attachments ) ) { $errors[] = 'Expected exactly six canonical demo-image attachments.'; }
if ( $errors ) { throw new RuntimeException( implode( ' ', $errors ) ); }
update_option( 'bhaivatech_playground_validation_ready', array( 'wordpress' => $wp_version, 'woocommerce' => WC_VERSION, 'products' => count( $products ), 'demo_images' => count( $attachments ) ) );
